model-value.desc: Time of the component; use v-model

format24h.desc: Forces 24 hour time display instead of AM/PM system

with-seconds.desc: Allow the time to be set with seconds

now-btn.desc: Display a button that selects the current time

hour-options.desc: Optionally configure what hours the user is allowed to set

minute-options.desc: Optionally configure what minutes the user is allowed to set

second-options.desc: Optionally configure what seconds the user is allowed to set

options.desc: Optionally configure what time the user is allowed to set

default-date.desc: The default date to use (YYYY/MM/DD) when model is unfilled

color.desc: Color name from the Quasar Color Palette

square.desc: Removes border-radius so borders are squared

flat.desc: Applies a flat design (no default shadow)

bordered.desc: Applies a default border to the component

dark.desc: Notify the component that the background is a dark color

default.desc: This is where additional buttons can go

update:model-value.desc: Emitted when the component needs to change the model; used by v-model
